notes.title: 1.0 is available now!
notes.content:
We've finished Little Fighters on Stream and with this release update we've added a complete overhaul to all minigames, based on the feedback you, dear users, have given us. All minigames have a new considerable balance to make them more enjoyable, such as a new way to play "Struggle" or a little improvement to explosive paint to make it more fluid and fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/008ab54f14e02a762849d960fe710eb066dab756.png[/img]

We've fixed many bugs related to minigames mainly, we've adjusted the visual interface a bit, however we're still working on it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/4394f1cdf80ea0a6382656a548ae2a6d4bcf11f2.png[/img]

We've added a new racing minigame called Crazy Cars, where you can participate in a crazy race with a very peculiar and unique vehicle. Play with your chat in an intense race full of obstacles which will be determined largely by chance. However, you can show off your skills in many Little Fighters on Stream minigames.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/2acb35929f4e8b2af247b9afbfb42872a1188618.png[/img]
We've updated the way to log in with your Twitch account, now you can do it in a faster and more convenient way.

We will be aware of your feedback so we can continue updating and deliver new mini games to you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/b3a4df7237d584d1605245620a994c3d291d85e6.png[/img]

notes.title: Penalties
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/418759a975570db1e6a352099137d4ce1f8f8ff9.png[/img]

Viewers: Wait your turn to write the DIRECTION with which you will throw the ball, remember that you have a limited time to write, at the end of the time you will shoot automatically. You will be penalized one life if you miss the shoot. Remember, the progress of the winner (Chat or Streamer) is shown on the left line.
Streamer: Move from left to right with the "A,S" keys trying  to catch the ball.

We hope you enjoy it, we continue preparing a new minigame and the new avatars that will soon be released.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/9b47e8c7c740ada6ae7f30636d94a0ff62045c84.png[/img]

notes.title: New minigame | Escape: The killer squid
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/e31ff24159dfabd404534433058717b659bc823a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/2de99807813ab58e43076953808d7b615e874b44.png[/img]
In this game you must reach the goal before time runs out. However, you must meet some rules in order to advance towards the goal. You can only move when the traffic light has turned green, if you move during the red light, you will be eliminated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/bfcf857f5378980da27b371a9350cee1b9f61d7c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/c8e82bbc7b1bb46623835c9229cc0d57f14b7e84.png[/img]

[b]When the traffic light is red[/b], the doll will turn and eliminate the player who is moving, so be very careful

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/7e3d24893afadb39be3060b70e4c7cb89d079730.png[/img]

[b]We have added 5 nice skins[/b], in addition to solving many bugs that have been reported to us.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/010ab1297446d8b094d1c5928576124ceffe4e24.png[/img]

We greatly appreciate that you report bugs and errors, the fastest way to contact us is by DM on our Twitter: @FigthersOn

Thank you very much to all: HAVE FUN!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/9b47e8c7c740ada6ae7f30636d94a0ff62045c84.png[/img]

notes.title: (Soon) ESCAPE: The Killer Squid | New MINIGAME
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Thank you very much for playing Little Fighters on stream, also for being interested in it.

In this small post we want to announce that very soon we will add a new minigame based on a very popular game, it has many names, but the formula is very fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/7e817c8fb0f9149a136107743788a49db9035216.png[/img]

Viewers should freeze when the lighjt is red and advance with a green light, all within a specified time. Otherwise they will be eliminated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/eedd6e10e00407174d85150d6251e834a1924e12.png[/img]

We plan to release the minigame as soon as possible.

We have also designed very fun new skins/avatars and more little things
All this and more in the upcoming and very soon new update of Little Fighters on Strea!

see you soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/9b47e8c7c740ada6ae7f30636d94a0ff62045c84.png[/img]

notes.title: Explosive Paint and Halloween
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/c26d73a00ec03adf20077e30396d64692c5c48ff.png[/img]
[b]Now we'll show you all the news that this update brings. Now join us on this journey![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/c521b1fac62f5e4074726734898eb94d14d66b7b.png[/img]
[b]Explosive Paint[/b]
We have been developing a fun minigame where the streamer tries to interpret a secret word into a paint. The chat must guess the correct word, otherwise everything will explode and all will lose.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/221f39f781eae96e857b4a94eb4b408edff6636e.png[/img]

But be careful, there are enemies who will try to make you lose by disabling your drawing tools or even erasing your painting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/3b7e23d074971d3409351ecdd3891389f553d905.png[/img]
Drawing is fun, you should give it a try
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/3e2b4b3d277cf15360af70a8a79967552ab8014f.png[/img]
Well, we have added these avatars. They will appear for free within the update.
Surely these 11 cause a lot of fear so... let's move on to the next added one. [i](Be careful with those 3 people who wear red)[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/eb441faff8530e026677c984b9e100a8e032b086.png[/img]
[b]Stage - Lobby[/b]
We have decorated the different stages and lobbies with the Halloween theme.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/fc7be6c09dd5b1d8505a42bacd6259cee65ddbef.png[/img]

We have added improvements to all mini games. We adjust the games following the advice and opinions of the community, in addition to making them much more fun!

[b]Juegardo[/b]
However "Juegardo" is the minigame with the most changes, we have added a form of difficulty so that it doesn't become eternal. Having reached a certain round of rim shots, the game will increase in difficulty through various conditions applied to the physics of the rim.

For now this is it, however we continue to listen to our community.
Help us decide what to improve and what our next mini game will be. You can contact us through our email, website or social networks.

[b]We hope you enjoy the update[/b], if there are bugs or errors let us know and we'll solve it right away.

E-mail: teamrobotblackhatsoporte@hotmail.com

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/9b47e8c7c740ada6ae7f30636d94a0ff62045c84.png[/img]

notes.title: An update is coming
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/373ce05f78dfac1a1d69a53459689c4029a7f439.png[/img]
This is a small announcement to talk a little about the new big update that will be available soon.

The main element that makes up the future update is the new minigame that we'll add to the Little Fighters on Stream mini games catalog. This minigame is called "Explosive Paint"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/57e6a6646ac4d509455b0f3c1c5cd6f0943d6561.png[/img]
[b]Why that name?[/b]
You will know very soon, however for now we can tell you that it is a fun mini game in which the streamer must demonstrate his artistic skills and the chat interpret it.

[b]Avatars[/b]
This update will come filled with the spirit of Halloween.
October is stained with horror and we propose a series of avatars that will be available in the soon update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/26715a1e119582a47a0a5631ad85c309536f1dbd.png[/img]
This and much more (like improvements to some minigames), coming soon in the upcoming free Little Fighters on Stream update. 
[i]Very soon available on Steam (we hope have the update available for next weekend).[/i]

notes.title: Minigames and news (Update v1.3)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/b3a4df7237d584d1605245620a994c3d291d85e6.png[/img]
We want to thank you all for playing Little Fighters on Stream.

The early access is going better than we expected and that makes us very happy. We're working on 2 new very funny mini games and with much more strategy and action, we hope to give more information about it soon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/86f7791796340e28e223a5088882c95702dd25b4.png[/img]

We would like you to give us feedback on this publication or on our social networks (about proposals for new mini games or to notify us of bugs). Your reviews are extremely important to us. We wait for your comments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/2c4299a26db59e664ffa4e7ff093fd89173683f6.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Fixed bugs[/b]: We fixed a couple of bugs present in mini game 1 and 2
[*] [b]We have adjusted the minigame 3[/b] "[b]Juegardo[/b]": Now participants have much more precision since can throw the hoop even with decimal numbers, for example : !1.2 - !3.6 - !4.9 and so on. Where the highest intensity is still 5.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/c82baad71085f903d74bdf36aaecbc71a03fd922.png[/img]
[*] [b]Small graphics update[/b]: specifically in menus and minigame 3.
[/list]

[b]Thanks for reading, all your comments are very welcome! :D[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40329169/9b47e8c7c740ada6ae7f30636d94a0ff62045c84.png[/img]
